description: I'm Duy Chris, a landscape astrophotographer, NOC engineer, and founder of SkyRadar (skyradar.vn), an AI-built weather and astronomy platform with 2,000+ downloads. I specialize in product design, geospatial data, automation, and AI-agent workflows. For Space Apps, I want to explore Mekong Delta land subsidence using NASA radar data. Seeking teammates skilled in SAR/InSAR, Earth science, GIS, or data visualization. Let's turn satellite data into real-world insight!
